# Human recording credits

Source: https://github.com/hugolpz/audio-cmn/tree/f759a0f18f27690742957619e1248ed91e9b3f2c

Isolated syllables: Chen Wang (王琛). Collection authors Wang Chen, Hugo Lopez, Nicolas Vion, 2013. CC BY-SA 3.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/ . Speaker and licence are embedded in the original files' SWAC metadata.

Whole words: Yue Tan, Base Audio Libre De Mots Chinois / Shtooka Caen Tan, copyright 2009. CC BY-SA 3.0 US: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/us/ . Licence documentation: https://github.com/trevorld/mandarin_audio_utilities/blob/master/cc_README.rst . MP3 processing and distribution by Hugo Lopez / audio-cmn.

Files are unchanged except for hashed filenames. Each original path, pinned download URL, licence, speaker and Git blob integrity hash appears in manifest.json. No synthesis, pitch changes, time stretching or syllable stitching is applied. Audio retains its original licence, separately from code and lesson text.

Known problem syllables reported in https://github.com/hugolpz/audio-cmn/issues/7 are excluded. Neutral-tone examples use whole-word recordings instead of the source's unsuitable isolated neutral-tone material. Independent native-speaker review of the remaining files is not claimed.

Readable credits: credits.html. Import and verification details: AUDIO.md in the project repository.
